steps.title: Tell us what it's doing
steps.desc: Blowing warm, tripping the breaker, leaking water, or a furnace that won't fire — pick the symptom, your home size, and how soon you need someone. Under a minute, no sign-up, works on any phone.

steps.title: See repair vs replace
steps.desc: An honest range built on Classic Services' own pricing — a repair when a repair is the right call, a replacement when the system is genuinely past it. Not a teaser number to get a tech in the door.

steps.title: Pick your service window
steps.desc: Choose a slot from the real schedule and you're confirmed on the spot. A licensed tech shows up, confirms the diagnosis, and gives you the final price before any work starts.
